scope_confirmation: Supercharts and trading workspace first; full platform backlog
reference_status: official-docs baseline; logged-in edition-specific catalog pending

phase_meanings.3: Advanced charts/trading and private read-only accounts
phase_meanings.5: Full platform and gated live-route expansion

dependency_semantics: Category prefixes are work-package dependencies; refine to item-level tasks in phase 0.
parity_policy: Only reference-catalog items with passing comparison evidence count as verified. Product extensions do not count toward strict parity.
